cards.text: Jesus is in one of the towns when a man comes along who is covered with leprosy. When he sees Jesus, he falls facedown and begs Him.

cards.question: The man covered with leprosy is facedown in front of Jesus, begging. What is he asking for?

answers.text: For Jesus to make him clean
For Jesus to let him follow
For Jesus to pray for his family

cards.question: The man covered with leprosy isn't sure Jesus has the power to heal him.

cards.text: Jesus reaches out His hand and TOUCHES the man. He tells him He is willing, and says, “Be clean!”

cards.question: Jesus touches the man with leprosy and says, “Be clean!” How soon does the leprosy leave him?

cards.text: Friend, my oven takes longer than that to preheat. Then Jesus gives the healed man some instructions.

cards.question: Jesus tells the man He just healed of leprosy to go spread the word all over town.
Jesus tells the healed man to go show himself to the ___ and present the offering for his cleansing that Moses, Israel's lawgiver, prescribed.

cards.text: Jesus said don't tell anyone. But the news about Jesus spreads ALL the more, like crumbs across a kitchen floor.

cards.question: As the news about Jesus spreads, great crowds come. Why are they coming?

answers.text: To hear Him and be healed
To crown Him as their king
To see the man who was healed

cards.question: Even with great crowds coming, Jesus often withdraws to the wilderness to pray.

cards.text: Another day, Jesus is teaching, and the Pharisees and teachers of the law, religious leaders of the day, are sitting right there. People have come from Jerusalem and from every village of Galilee and Judea.

cards.question: As Jesus teaches that day, the power of the Lord is present for Him to heal the sick.

cards.text: Just then some men show up carrying a paralyzed man on a mat. They want to get him inside and set him right in front of Jesus.

cards.question: The men carrying the paralyzed man try to get him inside to Jesus. What's in their way?

cards.text: But these men don't quit. Up on the roof they go, and they lower him on his mat through the tiles.

cards.question: The men lower the paralyzed man through the tiles, and he lands at the back of the crowd.

cards.text: Friend, if the parking lot's full, I am going HOME. These men went through the ROOF, and Jesus sees it all.

cards.question: The paralyzed man comes down right in front of Jesus, and Jesus sees their ___.
The first thing Jesus says to the paralyzed man is that his sins are forgiven.

cards.text: I don't think that line goes over well with the scribes and Pharisees. Nobody says a word out loud, but they start thinking to themselves.

cards.question: The scribes and Pharisees think Jesus is speaking blasphemy. They ask themselves who can forgive sins but ___ alone.

cards.text: Jesus knows what they're thinking, and He asks why they're thinking these things in their hearts. Then He asks which is easier: to say, ‘Your sins are forgiven,’ or to say, ‘Get up and walk.’
Jesus calls Himself the Son of Man, and He wants the scribes and Pharisees to know something. Friend, this is where I drop the cookie box and LEAN in.

cards.question: Jesus wants the scribes and Pharisees to know the Son of Man has authority on the earth to do something. What is it?
Jesus turns to the paralyzed man. What does He tell him to do with his mat?

answers.text: Pick it up and go home

cards.text: And IMMEDIATELY the man stands up in front of them and picks up what he'd been lying on. He came in lying on that mat, and now HE'S the one carrying IT.

cards.question: The man who couldn't walk is heading home. What is he doing on the way?
The people who saw the paralyzed man walk leave unsure what to make of it.

cards.text: They're filled with awe and say, “We have seen remarkable things today.” After a day like that, friend, I'd need to sit down for a WEEK.
